flora: Tree Ferns (tall fibrous trunks, massive delicate canopy fronds)
Mosses and Liverworts covering the ground
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the atmospheric moisture; the fronds should look delicate and airy.

visual_logic.composition: A misty view inside a dense thicket of Tree Ferns, where the light struggles to filter through the complex, overlapping canopy of delicate fronds.
visual_logic.ground: Spongy, moist forest soil with a thick carpet of bryophytes.
visual_logic.lighting: Misty morning light, diffused and cool, enhancing the texture of the moss.
